My plot is very small, just 0.17 hectares, so my family and I can manage all the work ourselves without hiring anyone. I will plant the improved maize seed I received through the government program and apply both the small bag of chemical fertilizer I could access and some manure from my livestock. I cannot afford pesticides or herbicides, so we will pull the weeds by hand when the rains come. We depend entirely on rainfall because we have no way to irrigate here in Lilongwe.
